meta_description: OpenDrone pre-order rounds. Explore the batches, prices and ship dates. EU and US retailers can request a bulk quote.
title: Pre-orders
timeline_eta: Ships if the target is reached
stack_title: FC and ESC from Belgium, EU addresses only
targets_line: One order ships in one parcel, when its last item is ready. Want the FC and ESC in {month}? Order them separately.
empty_newsletter_title: Get the next batch by email
faq_a_cancel: Any time before delivery. Full refund. [Withdrawal form](/en/herroepingsrecht#withdraw)
faq_q_missed: What if the target is not reached?
faq_a_missed: We email you. You choose a refund, or to wait for the new date in that email. If you do not reply within 30 days, we refund you within the next 14 days. You can also cancel any time before delivery.
faq_q_eta: What if the ship date moves?
faq_a_eta: We email you the new date. You can still cancel any time before delivery.
faq_a_shops: To the countries listed at checkout. Shipping and any sales tax are confirmed before you pay. Outside the EU and US, you may pay import charges on delivery. Shops can [apply for wholesale access](/wholesale).
